# Tatum

> Multi-chain blockchain developer platform: managed RPC, APIs, webhooks, wallets, and pricing data across 100+ networks.

Tatum helps teams build wallets, exchanges, payments, DeFi, gaming, and NFT products without running their own nodes. Core offerings include a managed RPC gateway (smart routing, failover, geo balancing), unified REST APIs, on-chain event notifications, smart wallets (WaaS), and real-time crypto price data. For anything time-sensitive (supported chains, rate limits, pricing), treat live docs as the source of truth.

## Products

- [RPC Nodes](https://tatum.io/products/nodes.md): Unlimited RPC access to 120+ chains
- [RPC Router](https://tatum.io/gateway): Intelligent RPC routing — load balancing, method routing, failover, caching, and BYO endpoints
- [Blockchain Data API](https://tatum.io/products/data-api.md): Balances, transactions, tokens, NFTs
- [Notifications](https://tatum.io/products/notifications.md): On-chain webhooks and event subscriptions
- [Smart Wallets](https://tatum.io/products/wallets.md): Wallet-as-a-Service (WaaS)
- [Crypto Price API](https://tatum.io/products/price-api.md): Real-time exchange rates

## Docs & platform

- [API documentation](https://docs.tatum.io): Authoritative API reference and guides
- [Dashboard](https://dashboard.tatum.io): API keys, projects, and usage
- [Status page](https://status.tatum.io/): Incidents and uptime
- [Changelog](https://docs.tatum.io/changelog): Product and API updates
- [Support](mailto:support@tatum.io): support@tatum.io

## Agents

- [AI.tatum.io llms.txt](https://ai.tatum.io/llms.txt): MCP tools, workflows, chain registry, and OpenAPI for agents
- [Agent manifest](https://ai.tatum.io/.well-known/tatum-agent.json): Machine-readable entrypoint (counts, routing, endpoints)
- [Blockchain MCP](https://ai.tatum.io/mcp.md): Runtime tools for MCP clients across 100+ networks
- [Integration Skill](https://ai.tatum.io/integration-skill.md): Code-generation skill for coding agents

## Optional

- [Homepage](https://tatum.io): Marketing site overview
- [Full AI site index](https://ai.tatum.io/llms-full.txt): Concatenated agent docs when a client cannot follow links
- [RPC Nodes (HTML)](https://tatum.io/products/nodes): Human-facing product page
- [Blockchain Data API (HTML)](https://tatum.io/products/data-api): Human-facing product page
- [Notifications (HTML)](https://tatum.io/products/notifications): Human-facing product page
- [Smart Wallets (HTML)](https://tatum.io/products/wallets): Human-facing product page
- [Crypto Price API (HTML)](https://tatum.io/products/price-api): Human-facing product page
